text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is an overview article describing the development and validation of a national carbon accounting model (FullCAM) for greenhouse gas emissions from land systems in Australia. It focuses on carbon and nitrogen cycling, ecosystem modeling, and greenhouse gas accounting. Although it uses land cover change data from remote sensing, it does not primarily focus on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or scenario simulation with mapped spatial LULC projections. The modeling is centered on carbon and nitrogen mass balance and greenhouse gas emissions, not on simulating or predicting LULC change scenarios. There is no implementation of ≥2 future LULC scenarios with quantitative comparison, nor spatial accuracy metrics for LULC predictions. The scale is national, but the primary focus is biomass/carbon accounting rather than LULC prediction. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction research and is not a review article focused on LULC prediction.)
